Chairperson’s Message
It is my great pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Accounting and Finance at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, Garden Campus. Since its establishment, the department has remained committed to academic excellence, professional development, and research innovation in the fields of accounting, finance, auditing, and taxation.
In today’s fast-changing financial world, the demand for qualified professionals who can respond to economic challenges with integrity and expertise is greater than ever. Our department is dedicated to equipping students with the technical skills, analytical tools, and ethical foundation required to meet these demands and to thrive in both public and private sector organizations, nationally and internationally.
We offer a range of academic programs including BS (Accounting and Finance), BS commerce, BS Banking and Finance, BS Fin Tech, MS, and PhD, all designed to build strong conceptual understanding and applied skills. Our curriculum is continuously updated to reflect current market trends, technological advancements, and the evolving regulatory environment. Moreover, we strive to foster a culture of research that encourages students and faculty alike to engage in scholarly work that contributes to the financial sector and policymaking.
The department also maintains a strong focus on soft skills, including communication, leadership, and professional ethics, to ensure our graduates not only excel in technical competence but also emerge as responsible and visionary professionals.
I invite you to explore the opportunities offered by our department, whether as a prospective student, a researcher, or a collaborator from industry or academia. Together, we aim to build a better future through education, innovation, and integrity.
Dr. Ihtesham Khan
Chairman
Department of Accounting and Finance
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
